scripts: scripts/spike-10/refresh_test.py (runs on the throwaway app appmux-spike-10)

refresh_run.setup: a supervisor process holds the SP client id and secret; it started three child processes with no client id, secret or inherited token, each calling WorkspaceClient().current_user.me() with an unmodified Databricks SDK every 300 s for 4200 s. A: DATABRICKS_METADATA_SERVICE_URL pointing at a local HTTP endpoint the supervisor serves. B: DATABRICKS_AUTH_TYPE=databricks-cli with DATABRICKS_CLI_PATH naming a stub script that prints a token file the supervisor rewrites. C (control): DATABRICKS_TOKEN set once to the token minted at start. The supervisor re-minted when less than 600 s of life was left.
refresh_run.child_sandbox: none: the children were plain subprocesses of the supervisor, not namespace-sandboxed
mints: 0s  supervisor minted a token a3097df9, real life 3600 s, advertised 3600 s
3000s  supervisor minted a token 2b8fd306, real life 3600 s, advertised 3600 s
refresh_run.sdk_behaviour: A and B switched to the new token only after the old one expired (first call after t+3600 s used the token minted at t+3000 s); the SDK asked the metadata service for a new token at t+3605 s
refresh_run.control_failure: C failed from its first call after expiry (t+3603 s) with PermissionDenied: 'unable to parse response' (the 401 body is not JSON); it succeeded at t+3302 s

dry_run: advertised token life 90 s, 180 s, children A and B every 20 s: both children picked up each of the four tokens minted (t+0, 60, 120 s and 180 s) with no failed call
